title: Parcel records
description: Every answer this Actor produces goes to the default dataset, one item per parcel. A refusal is an item too: it carries the same jurisdiction and source keys as an answer, so a caller fanning out across counties can read the whole result set the same way. The shape of an item and its five controlled vocabularies are declared in the dataset schema.

records.title: Parcel records
records.description: The dataset holding this run's answers and refusals.
